title: Pay and recording fees with Henderson
summary: Scott made enough to live on and was paid extra for recordings.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Getting paid: wages, scale and the pay envelope

blocks.x: What about money? What kind of money did you make in the Henderson band?
I made sufficiently, we made sufficiently to live, more than I had been making.
Did you get extra for recording?
Oh, yes, yeah, all that was extra, sure. A lot of recordings. In this respect, I had been playing before then mostly popular music. And we had to make a lot of music that was more on the blues side.
